'''Wallugget''' was a particularly large and dangerous [[Walluga]] skullsmasher that lived in a group of wallugas on [[Rryatt Trail#The Common Paths|the Common Paths]] of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
Wallugget was a creature in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It could be found on the Common Paths level of the Rryatt Trail. It was a level 54 [[:w:c:swg:Elite|Gold Chevron elite]], which meant that it was much stronger and tougher than normal wallugas and even posed a threat to players with higher levels. It was not involved in any quest, though players have to cross the small area with Wallugget and a group of other wallugas to reach the next level of the Rryatt trail.
